title: ADRs for AI: Human-AI Collaboration Template A
description: The canonical template of ADRs for AI (ADRs4AI) — git-native tooling for deliberative programming: human-AI collaboration in which decisions are first-class, durable artifacts. Humans and AI agents co-author Architectural Deliberation Records (ADRs) and seeds in a question-and-answer grammar that tooling can parse; every open question carries a reasoned, attributed recommendation, so deciding starts from carried reasoning rather than a blank page; inbox and crew protocols extend one deliberation record across multi-agent, multi-vendor teams. The template's own development record is the first specimen: the method ships demonstrated in the substrate it was built with.
